chapter: Early influences, Oliver date and trombone peers
title: Sidney Bechet and the Saratoga Club records
summary: He first met Bechet at the Saratoga Club and recalls a fine record with Sy Oliver arrangements.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: When did you start coming in contact with Sidney Bechet? Moshey (?)?
We were, Uh, let's see. I was back, this was down in Saratoga, Club, and he came from Chicago, too, and (Errol Finan (?)) sat in with us and then I started making records with you know-
Do you happen to remember what year that was?
I sure don't remember but I know it was a helluva record. I'll never forget that. Sy Oliver made the arrangements, yeah. I have them, too.
